storyCards.headline: Mouth: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Merril Bainbridge's "Mouth" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Mouth" is a song written by Australian singer-songwriter Merril Bainbridge and produced by Siew for Bainbridge's debut album, The Garden (1995).

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart.

Mouth was released in 1996.
